name: inflight
description: Visual review for previews and prototypes. Share a link, let reviewers pin comments and record walkthroughs on the live page, and read the feedback back in chat.

interface.longDescription:
Inflight is visual review for previews and prototypes.

Share a prototype or page you built here and get an inflight.co link with the Inflight widget on it. Reviewers open the link, pin comments to the exact element they mean, react, and record a short walkthrough. Nothing to install on their side.

Back here, ask what feedback came in. Inflight quotes each reviewer verbatim with the page path and whether the comment is already addressed, then lists the next steps it derived from the discussion. Mark each one done as you address it.

Who it is for: designers, product managers and engineers who review work on the running thing rather than in a document.

What it does not do: it does not host production sites, manage billing, or change your code from this chat. Sharing a deployed preview of a codebase is done from a coding agent that has the repository checked out; the feedback still reads back here.
capabilities: Share an HTML prototype for review
defaultPrompt: Share this prototype with Inflight for review
What feedback came in on my Inflight previews?
Implement the feedback that came in on my Inflight prototype

positive.description: Share a prototype built in the chat
positive.prompt: Build a simple one-page pricing table in HTML with three plans, then share it with Inflight for review.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant writes a complete HTML file, calls share_html with it, and replies with an inflight.co/p/ link, explaining that reviewers can open it and pin comments on the page.

positive.prompt: What feedback came in on my Inflight previews?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_feedback with no arguments and lists the reviewer account's recent versions that have open feedback, grouped by project, then offers to open one in full.

positive.description: Read the feedback on one shared page
positive.prompt: Show me the feedback on https://inflight.co/p/xvo1pj4scjvy
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_feedback with that url and quotes each reviewer's comments verbatim with the reviewer's name, the page path, and whether each is addressed, followed by the version's next steps.
The assistant calls list_projects and shows the demo workspace's projects with their folder and latest version overview.

positive.description: Complete a next step after acting on it
positive.prompt: On https://inflight.co/p/xvo1pj4scjvy, I fixed the first open next step. Mark it done.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant calls get_feedback with that url to find the first open next step's id, calls complete_next_step with it, and confirms which step was completed.

negative.prompt: Delete all of my Inflight projects right now.

negative.description: Sharing a private or local address

negative.prompt: Upgrade my Inflight plan and add three more seats.

review.commerce_description: Inflight does not sell anything through the plugin. Users sign in to their existing Inflight account; billing is managed on inflight.co.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: share HTML prototypes for review, read reviewer feedback verbatim, and complete next steps from ChatGPT.
